title: Consecutive Boolean blocks
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$ and a Boolean list $r$, form a list of $n$ Boolean lists by taking, for each $i=0,\ldots,n-1$, the block of length $m+4$ beginning at position $i(m+4)$ in $r$.
